sourceEvidence.text: Boy appears in medieval English as boie with uses around a young male servant or a disparaged young person, before the general male-child use. Its origin is unknown. Suggested French or Germanic connections compete; none should be presented as a secure chain. The medieval common noun should not be confused with an earlier proper name of similar spelling.
